_comment: Ratchet baseline for off-vocabulary (not-in-VALID_SEMANTIC) semantic tags. Maps entry file path -> the off-vocab semantic tags it already carried when generated. `build/validate_tags.py --check-no-new-unknown` (run in CI) fails if any entry gains an off-vocab tag absent from its list here, so the off-vocab set can only shrink via gradual migration, never grow. Regenerate after a migration: python3 build/validate_tags.py --write-unknown-baseline
